items.markdown:
`Dentists generally recommend teeth whitening when it is done safely and supervised by a professional` . They advise checking your oral health first because bleaching agents can harm your gums, damage weak enamel, or fail to work on fillings and crowns.[](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4058574/) [[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4058574/)[[2]](https://www.unitedconcordia.com/business-services/employers/blog/pros-cons-teeth-whitening-good-idea)[[3]](https://www.goodrx.com/conditions/dental-care/is-teeth-whitening-safe)[[4]](https://www.ada.org/resources/ada-library/oral-health-topics/whitening)

Why Dentists Approve Whitening

- **Safe ingredients:** They use controlled amounts of hydrogen peroxide or carbamide peroxide.
- **Custom care:** Custom trays fit your teeth tightly so gel does not touch your gums.
- **Better results:** Professional treatments lift deep stains faster than store kits.[](https://www.goodrx.com/conditions/dental-care/is-teeth-whitening-safe) [[1]](https://www.goodrx.com/conditions/dental-care/is-teeth-whitening-safe)[[2]](https://www.ada.org/resources/ada-library/oral-health-topics/whitening)[[3]](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/all-topics-a-z/teeth-whitening)[[4]](https://www.mercierdental.com/post/can-a-dentist-whiten-teeth-in-one-visit/)[[5]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/is-teeth-whitening-safe)

Risks and Warnings

- **Tooth sensitivity:** Teeth can feel hot or cold after bleaching.
- **Gum irritation:** Strong chemicals can burn or sting your soft gum tissue.
- **No effect on fake teeth:** Whitening only works on real teeth, not on bonding, veneers, or crowns.[](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4058574/) [[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4058574/)[[2]](https://www.ada.org/resources/ada-library/oral-health-topics/whitening)[[3]](https://sexton-dental.com/blog/5-reasons-to-consider-teeth-bleaching-from-your-dentist/)[[4]](https://wiltonmanorsdental.com/teeth-whitening-at-home-vs-dentist/)[[5]](https://www.premierdentistrychicago.com/dental-services/cosmetic-dentistry/teeth-whitening/)

If you are thinking about whitening your teeth, tell me:

- Do you currently have any **sensitive teeth** or **gum issues**?
- Do you have any **fillings or crowns** on your front teeth?

I can help you figure out which whitening method is safest for you.
